title: 第一卷 风起时 第十五章 龟甲古术第一卷 风起时 第十六章 担山
content_zh:
;;
而按照图灵的说法，只要陈风骨当时主动将宝药上交给兵冢山，非但可以让他图灵获得一次功劳，得到灵兵。
他还可以进行劝说，给陈风骨一个加入兵冢山麾下的机会。
可只为了这么一个机会，就要将得手的宝药平白献出，好处都让图灵拿了。
尤其是，若图灵提前与他商量，一切还好说。
但他偏偏是暗中将兵冢山的人引来，没有给陈风骨留任何的余地。
这种行为在陈风骨看来，无异于是背信图利的小人勾当，让他觉得与对方走不到一块去。
包括兵冢山等人所表现出来的强硬态度，也让陈风骨觉得自己与他们不是一类人，更没有加入的想法了。
最终，他在表示拒绝之后，带着宝药想要离去，却被兵冢山的人围攻。
正因如此，才有了后面陈风骨重伤逃回百丈山，不治身亡的事。
陈风奇在听完这一切后，心中的火气逐渐升腾，看图灵的目光越发冰冷。
虽说图灵话里话外，都暗指当初是为了陈风骨好。
可陈风奇又不傻，如何能听不出来，对方完全就是在损人利己
甚至于，后面围攻陈风骨，恐怕不止有兵冢山的人，图灵大概也参与进去了。
“兵冢山吗？”
陈风奇目露寒光，轻轻呢喃了一句。
许是感受到了他眼中越来越强烈的杀意，图灵面露惶恐，连忙开口。
“我承认，那件事的确是我做得理亏，是我对不起陈兄。”
“但我保证，先前所言，绝无半分虚假，重伤陈兄的人，是兵冢山的三把手。”
“你要报仇，应该去找兵冢山的人，我可以给你提供我所知道的一切情报。”

“还有，我可以告诉你一个有关我龟甲村的秘密！”
图灵为了活命，一股脑将心中的想法全都说了出来。
陈风奇深深地看了他一眼，暂时压下了心中杀意，用乾坤布将之包裹起来，扛在身后，只让他露出半个头颅。
“指个路，先带我去龟甲村。”
虽说报仇的事很重要，可陈风奇也明白，不能急于一时。
因为之前图灵就曾透露过，兵冢山绝非善茬。
其内有一个山主，据说在一年前，就有凝气七层修为。
哪怕是那所谓的三把手，如今也有至少凝气六层的修为，不是现在的他能面对的。
当下之际，还是先找一个可以暂时落脚的避风村要紧。
万一夜幕忽然降临，至少有一条退路。
之前图灵就透露过，龟甲村除了他们六个，并无其他人，刚好可以当成落脚地。
大概半个时辰后，陈风奇就远远看到了一片朦胧光影。
他没有立马过去，而是转眸看向了图灵，道：“如果你敢耍心眼，应该知道下场。”
他也担心，怕图灵带他来的不是龟甲村，而是兵冢山，让他来自投罗网。
于是出言提醒对方，一旦发现有任何不对，自己都会在第一时间将他诛杀。
图灵忙道：“放心，前面就是龟甲村，你直接进去就行。”

According to Turing, as long as Chen Fenggu took the initiative to hand over the treasure to Bingzhong Mountain at that time, not only would Turing be able to gain a credit and obtain a spiritual weapon.
He can also persuade and give Chen Fenggu a chance to join Bingzhongshan.
But just for such an opportunity, he had to give away the treasure he had obtained, and Turing took all the benefits.
Especially if Turing had discussed it with him in advance, everything would have been easier.
But he secretly attracted the people from Bingzhong Mountain, leaving no room for Chen Fenggu.
In Chen Fenggu's view, this kind of behavior was nothing more than a villain's act of betrayal and profit, which made him feel that he could not get along with the other party.
The tough attitude shown by Hyotsukayama and others also made Chen Fenggu feel that he was not the same kind of person as them, let alone the idea of ​​joining.
Finally, after expressing his refusal, he took the treasure and wanted to leave, but was besieged by the people of Bingzhong Mountain.
Because of this, Chen Fenggu was seriously injured and fled back to Baizhang Mountain, where he died.
After hearing all this, Chen Fengqi's anger gradually rose, and his eyes on Turing became colder.
Although Turing's words both implicitly and externally alluded to it being for Chen Fenggu's good.
But Chen Fengqi is not stupid, how could he not hear that the other party is completely benefiting himself at the expense of others?
What's more, when Chen Fenggu was besieged later, not only people from Bingzhongshan, but also Turing was probably involved.
"Hyozukayama?"
Chen Fengqi's eyes flashed coldly and he murmured softly.
Perhaps he could feel the growing murderous intent in his eyes. Turing looked horrified and spoke quickly.
"I admit that I did something wrong, and I was sorry for Brother Chen."
"But I promise that what I said before is absolutely not false. The person who seriously injured Brother Chen is the third in command of Bingzhong Mountain."
"If you want revenge, you should go to the people in Bingzhong Mountain. I can provide you with all the information I know."
"Also, I can tell you a secret about my Turtle Shell Village!"
In order to survive, Turing said all his thoughts at once.
Chen Fengqi took a deep look at him, temporarily suppressed the murderous intention in his heart, wrapped him in Qiankun cloth, and carried him behind him, leaving only half of his head exposed.
"Show me the way. Take me to Turtle Shell Village first."
Although revenge is very important, Chen Fengqi also understands that he cannot rush it.
Because Turing has revealed before that Bingzhong Mountain is definitely not a good place.
There is a mountain master inside, who is said to have achieved the seventh level of Qi Condensation a year ago.
Even the so-called third in command now has at least the sixth level of Qi Condensation, which is not something he can face now.
At this moment, it is important to find a sheltered village where you can stay temporarily.
If night falls suddenly, at least there is a way out.
Turing had previously revealed that except for the six of them, there was no one else in Turtle Village, so it was just a good place to stay.
About half an hour later, Chen Fengqi saw a hazy light and shadow in the distance.
He did not go over immediately, but turned to look at Turing and said: "If you dare to play tricks, you should know the consequences."
He was also worried that Turing would bring him not to Turtle Armor Village but to Bingzhong Mountain, so that he could fall into a trap.
So he reminded the other party that if he found anything wrong, he would kill him as soon as possible.
Turing said hurriedly: "Don't worry, there is Turtle Shell Village ahead, you can just go in."
